title: Argentinian Fish Wrap with Nam Pla Sauce
description: A flavorful and festive dish from Argentina, featuring a yeasty corn-husk wrap filled with fish, nam pla sauce, and crispy toast. Perfect for a light lunch or dinner.
instructions: Combine yeast, flour, salt, and warm water in a bowl to make the corn-husk dough. Let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 4-6 pieces, depending on the desired wrap size. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the fish for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
Mix the nam pla sauce with cilantro and red pepper flakes in a small bowl.
Assemble the wraps by spreading a tablespoon of nam pla sauce on each dough disk, followed by a piece of cooked fish, some toasted bread cubes, and a sprinkle of cilantro.
Brush the tops of the wraps with a little water and cook in the skillet for 1-2 minutes, until golden brown and crispy.
